reply_text: You're right, and that's mostly how things already work. The registry refuses a "narrower" grade unless problem.md itself is defective, so a narrower statement can't quietly close a problem. Let me check whether anything narrower got in anyway:I've saved this as a standing rule in memory and in the queue notes. From now on, problems blocked by missing theory stay open with the gap written down, and repairs either reach a faithful statement or the problem stays open. If you'd rather leave the three narrowed problems out of the closure counts altogether, I can do that instead of listing them separately.
